summary: Iteration 21 - Backend 13/13 PASS covering the 4 new features (Export Comptable, Badges Fidélité, Alerte Nouveau Filleul, Notes Clients). Frontend testIDs on the 4 feature surfaces (open-payouts-admin, payouts-export-csv, payouts-export-pdf, open-commissions, comm-tier, partner-new, saved-guests, guest-chip-<id>, guest-name) are all present in source. Programmatic UI walkthrough was blocked because the bottom tab-bar (Dashboard/Clients/Employees/Company for hotel; Home/Private/Team/Documents/Earnings/Profile for driver) exposes no data-testid, so I could not navigate to Profile / Company / Clients reliably via Playwright. Reporting per loop-prevention rule after 3 attempts.

issues: Bottom-nav tab buttons have no testID (Dashboard/Clients/Employees/Company on hotel, Home/Private/Team/Documents/Earnings/Profile on driver). This blocks Playwright navigation and prevented the reviewer from reaching the 3 UI acceptance criteria (open-payouts-admin, open-commissions/comm-tier, partner-new→saved-guests). Add e.g. testID='tab-company', 'tab-clients', 'tab-profile' on each tab button.

action_items: Add testID props to the bottom TabBar buttons (both driver shell and company shell) so UI navigation is testable. Suggested: tab-driver-home, tab-driver-private, tab-driver-team, tab-driver-documents, tab-driver-earnings, tab-profile, tab-company-dashboard, tab-company-clients, tab-company-employees, tab-company.

Once tabs have testIDs, main agent can self-verify the 3 UI flows (moderator payout export sheet, comm-tier card, saved-guests chip prefilling guest-name). All feature-level testIDs already exist in source, so no other change is needed for testability.

Optional consistency: frontend uses process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL while the platform contract calls for EXPO_BACKEND_URL. Both env keys exist historically but standardising would avoid confusion in future audits (not a bug, code works).
critical_code_review_comments: routes/company.py is ~490 lines and mixes 6 concerns (join/leave, employees, exports, partner bookings, commissions/payouts, saved-guests). Consider splitting into modules (company_business.py, company_partner.py, company_admin.py, company_guests.py).
PartnerBookingForm.tsx useEffect on line 32 has [visible] dep-array but references token/setGuests without listing them; React would warn. Not a functional bug (fine because tokens don't change).

test_iteration21.py::TestAlerteNouveauFilleul uses direct Motor DB access + requests: works, but a request-only assertion (e.g. checking sponsor_id via /auth/me after applying a code) would be more portable.

success_rate.frontend: not verified (blocked by missing tab testIDs; loop-prevention stop)

seed_data_creation: Test creates and cleans one TEST_Guest_*, one TEST_Booked_* guest (auto-deleted). One partner_lead + one new passenger 'Filleul Test' account created per run (small leftover in DB but harmless).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend feature parity fully verified with tests/test_iteration21.py. To test UI: after main agent adds testIDs on the bottom nav, follow these deep-links: (driver login) tab-profile → open-payouts-admin → payouts-export-csv / payouts-export-pdf; (hotel login) tab-company → open-commissions → comm-tier; (hotel login) tab-clients → partner-new → saved-guests → guest-chip-<id> then read guest-name value. All feature-level testIDs are already in the components (see PayoutsAdmin.tsx, PartnerCommissions.tsx, PartnerBookingForm.tsx).
rca_of_issue: N/A - no functional bug found. Only UI-testability gap: absence of testID on bottom-tab buttons prevented Playwright navigation.
